name: linkedin
description: LinkedIn invitations and inbox, read from your own logged-in session: list, accept or ignore pending invitations, list recent conversations, read a thread, remove a connection. Nothing sends on your behalf.

tools.name: list_invitations
tools.description: List pending received connection invitations: id (profile slug), name, headline, note (the message they attached, if any), mutual connection count, profile URL.

tools.name: accept_invitation
tools.description: Accept one pending invitation by id (profile slug from list_invitations). Reversible later with remove_connection. dry_run reports what would be clicked.

tools.name: ignore_invitation
tools.description: Ignore one pending invitation by id. Not reversible: the sender is not told, but the invitation is gone. dry_run reports what would be clicked.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List recent conversations from the messaging inbox: other participant (name, headline, distance, profile URL), last message (text, time, whether you sent it), unread count. category PRIMARY_INBOX is the Focused tab, SECONDARY_INBOX is Other.

since.description: ISO date; stop at conversations older than this.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read one conversation in full by conversation_id (from list_conversations): every message with sender, time, and whether you sent it. Use it to tell a pitch from a conversation.

tools.name: remove_connection
tools.description: Remove a 1st-degree connection. The call must pass page: the person's profile URL (https://www.linkedin.com/in/<slug>/) and id: <slug>. Silent for them. dry_run stops before the confirmation.

reads.label: Reads
reads.help: Listing invitations and conversations, reading a thread.

actions.label: Actions
actions.help: Accepting, ignoring, removing. These change your account.
